## Figure 1.21: Net Transfers on Public and Publicly Guaranteed Debt in IDA-Eligible Countries, by Creditor Type, 2023–25
Horizontal grouped bar chart.

- **Units:** US$ (billions)
- **X-axis:** approximately from **–10 to 80**
- **Y-axis / categories:** two creditor groups, each with four measures:
  - **PPG official:** Interest; Amortization; Disbursements; Net transfers
  - **PPG private:** Interest; Amortization; Disbursements; Net transfers
- **Legend / series:** 2023, 2024, 2025
- **Time span:** 2023–25

### Values shown by bar length
Values are estimated from bar positions against the axis grid.

#### PPG official
| Measure | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Interest | ≈13.2 | ≈15.9 | ≈15.0 |
| Amortization | ≈29.0 | ≈32.6 | ≈33.3 |
| Disbursements | ≈75.2 | ≈70.2 | ≈63.9 |
| Net transfers | ≈33.2 | ≈21.8 | ≈15.1 |

#### PPG private
| Measure | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Interest | ≈6.0 | ≈7.6 | ≈9.0 |
| Amortization | ≈9.8 | ≈13.2 | ≈13.5 |
| Disbursements | ≈12.8 | ≈24.3 | ≈27.9 |
| Net transfers | ≈2.7 | ≈3.6 | ≈4.9 |

### Visual comparisons and trends
- **Largest values in the figure:** PPG official **disbursements** in all three years, peaking at about **$75 billion in 2023**.
- **Smallest positive values:** PPG private **net transfers**, rising from about **$2.7 billion** in 2023 to **$4.9 billion** in 2025.
- **PPG official net transfers** decline steadily:
  - ≈33.2 in 2023
  - ≈21.8 in 2024
  - ≈15.1 in 2025
- **PPG private net transfers** increase each year:
  - ≈2.7 in 2023
  - ≈3.6 in 2024
  - ≈4.9 in 2025
- For **PPG official**, **disbursements** fall from 2023 to 2025, while **interest** and **amortization** are broadly higher in 2024–25 than in 2023.
- For **PPG private**, **disbursements**, **interest**, and **amortization** all rise over the three years.
- In every case shown, **disbursements exceed interest and amortization individually**.
- No bars appear negative; all **net transfers remain positive** for both creditor types in all three years.
- In 2025, **PPG official net transfers** are still much larger than **PPG private net transfers** (about **$15.1 billion** versus **$4.9 billion**).

**Source:** World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.  
**Note:** IDA = International Development Association; PPG = public and publicly guaranteed.
